purpose: Fresh, leakage-resistant selection and production gating for a 30-day global electricity forecast model.
short_context_policy: For series with 270-364 observed days, left-pad to 365 with the earliest observed value; no future observation is used.
selection_rule: All architecture, checkpoint, blend, calibration, and post-processing choices use known-series validation targets only. Cold-series targets remain inaccessible until selection.json is written.

portugal.name: UCI ElectricityLoadDiagrams20112014
portugal.interval_conversion: 15-minute kW divided by 4 and summed by day

morocco.name: UCI High-Resolution Load Dataset from Smart Meters Across Various Cities in Morocco
morocco.role: development selection and post-selection diagnostic only

tetouan.name: UCI Power Consumption of Tetouan City
tetouan.role: fresh, geographically distinct production gate; source was identified and this protocol was frozen before download or target access

portugal.eligible_policy: active by 2013-01-01 and positive on at least 90% of 2013-2014 days

morocco.validation_policy: two 30-day windows immediately before the final 90 days of each known series
morocco.diagnostic_policy: three non-overlapping 30-day windows covering the final 90 complete days of each cold series; targets were first accessed during a pipeline smoke test and are excluded from production promotion

tetouan.training_access: none; no Tetouan observation is used for training, selection, blending, calibration, or refitting
tetouan.locked_test_policy: three non-overlapping 30-day windows covering the final 90 complete days of each of the three zones
tetouan.weather_policy: weather columns bundled with the source are not used because realized 30-day future weather would not be available in production

candidate_family.foundation: amazon/chronos-2 with LoRA domain adaptation selected from 100, 300, and 600 update steps
candidate_family.interval: validation-only asymmetric conformal calibration of the 0.1/0.9 quantiles

promotion_policy: Promote only if every Tetouan fresh-transfer and artifact gate passes. Portugal and Morocco reserved sets are reported as diagnostics because their targets were opened during pipeline smoke testing before the final full run. A failed candidate remains a research artifact and does not replace backend production artifacts.
